The evidence is supported by a direct indication pathway, though the exact mechanism of action linking Prasterone to SLE remains unclear. The strength of the evidence is moderate, as it relies on the indirect relationship through Belimumab, which may not directly indicate a causal link between Prasterone and SLE.
